title: IQAC Composition
body:
Core Committee Structure

The Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) is constituted under the chairmanship of the Head of the Institution (Principal) with a diverse membership to ensure a holistic approach to quality management. The composition is designed to include representatives from the teaching faculty, administrative staff, and local society to maintain transparency and broad-based decision-making.

Member Categories

The committee typically includes senior administrative officers, three to eight teachers, and one member from the Management. To ensure external perspectives, the body also includes nominees from the local society, students, and alumni. Additionally, representatives from employers, industrialists, and stakeholders are integrated to align academic outputs with industry requirements.

The Coordinator

A senior teacher acts as the Coordinator or Director of the IQAC. This individual is responsible for the effective functioning of the cell, coordinating the dissemination of information, and ensuring that the quality initiatives approved by the committee are implemented across all academic and administrative departments of the college.
